title: The Events page leads with Around you: the member's next event or best pick, three balanced cards, a live ticker and a map that opens as a lightbox, over a library four wide with a sticky sort bar

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16 on /events, with a screenshot: make the map part of the feature section as a pop up lightbox with sorting, search and controls; make a feature around you area out of the For you and Your week section; feature the latest upcoming or what they RSVPd to, balancing managing their events with suggestions; a dynamic ticker list, a few event cards, a map; the rest a truncated library four wide; sticky sort menus.

detail: Under the Frequency design the For you lane and the Your week side panel are gone, and the Map view is no longer a split beside the list. In their place, Around you (components/frequency/members/events/around-you.tsx) leads the page while the member is browsing (no search or filter set, List view): a header with their week in one plain line (You are going to 2 things this week, and 4 more picked for you around Encinitas), a pulse strip of what is live, starting within 12 hours, filling up or featured this week (a slow marquee that pauses on hover and stands still under reduced motion), then a spotlight and three cards on the left and the map door and a ticker on the right. planAroundYou (around-you-items.ts, unit tested) decides what leads: the member's own next event when it is inside a week, else their best ranked pick (with its plain why line), else what the operator featured, else the next thing coming up; the three cards keep the balance (at most one more of their own, then picks, then what is filling up, then the soonest, never the same event twice). The ticker has four tabs (Yours, For you, This week, Nearby with a home base), opens on Yours when they have anything, and each row carries a live signal (Live now, Starts in 2h 10m, 3 spots left) from the true event instant, refreshed every 30 seconds after mount so the first paint matches the server. The map tile is a still SVG preview of the privacy-safe pins (no map engine on the list) and opens the map lightbox (events-map-lightbox.tsx): a native modal dialog over the page, on ?map=1 written with history.pushState (the old ?view=map link opens it too; closing takes the param off), with search, a When segment (Any day, Today, This week, Weekend), a Sort segment (Soonest, Nearest with distances, Most going), category chips with counts, a Going toggle for a member, Reset, and the results list beside the live map (map on top on a phone, full screen); a pin lights and scrolls to its row, and each row has a Show on the map button that eases the map to it. The toolbar's view switch is List, Map (opens the lightbox) and Calendar. Below the feature the category tabs and the facet and sort menus share one bar that sticks under the toolbar while the library scrolls (a phone keeps the Filters sheet), and the library is four across (three, two, then one as the screen narrows), twelve cards at a time with Show more (?show=24, up to 60) and See all on the calendar. People to meet stays under the feature. Surface, text, ink and accent tokens only, so the night room reads. DAWN is unchanged.
